report.summary: Parsed final chunk of picker.py; exit logic and main dispatch.

handoff.purpose: Main entry point: parse JSON output, render queue, attempt top task, return exit code.

symbols.note: Defined earlier; here used as entry point. Calls attempt_fn or _default_attempt on top task.

claims.why: The code exactly prints JSON dump of queue when args.json is truthy.

claims.text: if not args.once: return EXIT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE if degraded else 0
claims.why: After JSON output, if not once, returns the conditional exit code.

claims.text: if not args.once: if not args.json: print(render_queue(queue, verbose=args.verbose))
claims.why: When not once and not json, renders and prints the queue.

claims.text: if degraded: print(...could not be consulted...)
claims.why: Prints degradation message when degraded is truthy.
Returns conditional exit code after non-once path.

claims.text: top = queue.top; if top is None: print('no evidence-backed candidate...')
claims.why: Assigns top, checks None, prints message.

claims.text: if degraded: print(...NOT evidence...) ; return EXIT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
claims.why: If degraded, prints special message and returns unavailable exit code.
Returns EXIT_FAILED when top is None and not degraded.
Prints attempt info with queue length, task_id, score.

claims.text: if not args.live: print('  runner is ADVISORY...')
claims.why: Prints advisory message when not live.
Calls run with top and args.
Returns exit code based on result state, defaulting to EXIT_FAILED.
Calls main() and exits with its return code.

observations.what: All exit code constants (EXIT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, EXIT_FAILED, EXIT_BY_STATE) are referenced but not defined in this chunk.
Functions render_queue, _console_safe, review_packet, _default_attempt are called but not defined here.
The conditional logic for args.once and args.json covers four paths: once+json, once+not json, not once+json, not once+not json. Each path is handled.
